title: Dependencies
summary: Italian-language register of architectural dependencies (runtime, Rust backend crates, frontend, persistence, JEV integration, AI models, caching, containers), each marked Decisa, Proposta, or Aperta.
scope: MVP exclusions (Kubernetes, service mesh, message broker, separate vector DB, agentic framework, distributed cache)
notes: Type set by manifest (SPEC). Entries carry per-item status: 'Decisa' = decided (frontend TS+React, backend Rust stable, argon2 as algorithm, PostgreSQL relational store with one cluster but per-service ownership, per-service SQL migrations); 'Proposta' = default pending spike, NOT locked (Tokio, Axum, sqlx, pgvector, JWT, reqwest, etc.); 'Aperta' = open question (OpenAPI tooling, PDF/DOCX storage, all AI models, caching, container setup). JEV section reads as a firm integration choice (direct HTTPS adapter, no SDK/sidecar) but has no explicit status label. Only external URLs referenced (docs.typesafe.ai/api, api.typesafe.ai/openapi.json, typesafe-ai SDK GitHub repos); no local doc cross-refs. Filename uses 'nohash' instead of the SHA-256 path prefix because no shell/hash tool was available to this classifier.
